test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

We all will be shift to our new house next month.
solution:
The erroneous part is '**will be shift' i.e. this part has an error.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace **shift **with **shifting**.
 
• The sentence is in **the future continuous tense.**
 
• Future continuous tense is formed using the construction** will + be + the present participle (the root verb + -ing).**
 
 
• I will be watching Michael's race.​
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 

**The correct sentence is**: We all will be ***shifting ***to our new house next month.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is important to note that the** future continuous tense** is only used with **action verbs **because it is possible to do them for a duration.
 
• **Action verbs **describe activities like** running, thinking, and seeing**.
 
• **Stative verbs **describe **states of existence, like being, seeming, and knowing**.
 
• To use the will + be + present participle construction with a stative verb would sound very odd indeed.
 
 
• I will be **stressed **tomorrow during my science test.
